title: Tesoro
desc: Developed a modern, responsive website for Tesoro, a gaming rewards platform that connects brands, merchants, and gamers through card-linked offers and in-game currency rewards.
overview: Tesoro: Building a Digital Experience for a Gaming Rewards Platform Project Overview Tesoro is a gaming rewards platform designed to connect everyday shopping with in-game rewards. By linking eligible Visa and Mastercard payment cards to participating offers, the platform enables gamers to earn virtual currency through qualifying purchases while helping merchants reach new customers and game studios create additional revenue opportunities. The project focused on presenting this innovative rewards ecosystem through a modern, engaging, and responsive website. The goal was to communicate a relatively complex business model in a way that feels intuitive to gamers, merchants, and gaming industry partners. The Challenge A platform serving multiple audiences needs a clear digital experience that communicates its value to each group without overwhelming visitors with technical details. Tesoro's website needed to explain how card-linked rewards work, demonstrate the benefits for different stakeholders, and guide visitors toward relevant information and calls to action. The challenge was to balance compelling visual storytelling with clear information architecture, accessible content, and a consistent brand experience. My Approach The approach focused on creating a structured, audience-oriented website that introduces the platform, explains its rewards mechanism, and directs visitors to dedicated sections based on their needs. Website Design and Development The website presents Tesoro as a modern gaming technology and rewards platform through a structured layout, prominent messaging, and clear content sections. The design emphasizes visual hierarchy and readability to help visitors understand the platform's purpose quickly. User Experience and Information Architecture The website organizes information around three primary audiences: gamers, merchants, and game studios. Dedicated sections help each audience explore the platform's benefits and understand how the rewards ecosystem fits their needs. <Cite refs={["turn981921view0","turn981921search4","turn981921search6"]}/> Gaming Rewards Platform Storytelling Explaining the connection between real-world purchases and virtual rewards requires a straightforward presentation of the process. The website communicates the core journey through four stages: connecting a payment card, activating an offer, completing a qualifying purchase, and receiving in-game rewards. Responsive Web Design The website was structured to provide a consistent browsing experience across desktop and mobile devices, maintaining accessible content, clear navigation, and recognizable calls to action across screen sizes. Conversion-Focused Landing Pages Calls to action, including waitlist registration and audience-specific entry points, help guide visitors toward the next step. The website's structure supports both product education and lead generation by making relevant information accessible to prospective users and business partners. Technologies and Tools Webflow: Website development and content management HTML & CSS: Page structure, styling, and responsive layouts JavaScript: Interactive functionality, where implemented Responsive Web Design: Adapting the experience across screen sizes UI/UX Design: Information hierarchy, navigation, and user journeys Project Outcome Tesoro's website presents a complex gaming rewards proposition through a structured digital experience built around its core audiences and value proposition. By combining audience-specific content, clear explanations of the rewards process, and prominent calls to action, the website helps communicate how the platform connects gaming, commerce, and loyalty. The project demonstrates my experience in website development, responsive web design, user experience, and creating digital experiences for technology-driven businesses.

title: Coaching with Maya
desc: Designed and developed a professional website for Coaching with Maya, presenting relationship coaching services, blended family support, coaching packages, and booking options through a warm, approachable, and user-focused digital experience.
overview: Coaching with Maya: A Digital Experience for Relationship Coaching Project Overview Coaching with Maya is a professional coaching website for Maya Stephan, a Dubai-based relationship coach specializing in blended families. The website helps individuals, couples, and families navigate relationship challenges, strengthen communication, establish boundaries, and build healthier family dynamics. The project focuses on creating a welcoming online presence that reflects Maya's personal approach to coaching while clearly communicating her services, packages, and booking options. The website combines thoughtful visual design, structured content, and accessible navigation to help visitors understand the coaching process and take the next step toward working together. The Challenge Relationship coaching is a personal service that requires trust, clarity, and a strong connection between the coach and prospective clients. Visitors may arrive looking for support with communication difficulties, family transitions, parenting roles, or recurring relationship conflicts. The challenge was to present these sensitive and often complex topics in a way that feels approachable without overwhelming visitors. The website needed to communicate Maya's expertise and lived experience, explain the available coaching options, and make it easy for individuals and families to explore services and schedule an introductory conversation. My Approach The website was structured around the needs of prospective coaching clients, combining personal storytelling, service information, and clear calls to action. The approach prioritizes readability, intuitive navigation, and a consistent experience across the main sections of the website. Website Design and Development The website establishes a professional digital presence that reflects the personal and supportive nature of Maya's coaching practice. The page structure guides visitors from the initial introduction to information about blended family coaching, Maya's background, available packages, and booking options. User Experience and Information Architecture The content is organized to help visitors understand the purpose of relationship coaching and identify the areas in which they may need support. Dedicated sections introduce common blended family challenges, including communication difficulties, differing expectations, parental roles, and recurring disagreements. This structured approach helps make the services easier to understand while allowing visitors to explore relevant information at their own pace. Personal Branding and Storytelling Maya's personal experience as part of a blended family is an important element of the website's messaging. The design and content structure bring her professional perspective and lived experience together, helping communicate the human side of her coaching practice. The goal was to create an online experience that feels personal and reassuring while maintaining a clear, professional presentation. Coaching Services and Package Presentation The website presents several coaching options, including an introductory discovery call, individual or couples sessions, a Foundations Package, and the Blended Family Reset program. Organizing these services into distinct sections helps visitors compare the available options, understand the general structure of the coaching process, and identify an appropriate starting point. Booking and Conversion Experience Calls to action are incorporated throughout the website to encourage visitors to book a complimentary assessment call. The booking section provides a straightforward entry point for prospective clients to explore whether the coaching service is right for their needs. By connecting service information with clear next steps, the website supports both service discovery and client enquiries. Responsive Web Design The website was designed to support browsing across desktop and mobile devices. Its content sections, navigation, and calls to action work together to provide a consistent experience for visitors accessing the site from different screen sizes. Key Website Features Relationship coaching service presentation Dedicated information about blended family coaching Individual, couples, and family coaching options Structured coaching package descriptions Personal branding and coach introduction Common relationship and family challenges section Complimentary discovery call booking Contact information and social media links Responsive website layout Technologies and Tools Web Development: Website structure and implementation HTML & CSS: Content structure, styling, and responsive layouts JavaScript: Interactive elements and frontend functionality, where implemented Booking Integration: Appointment scheduling functionality Project Outcome Coaching with Maya brings together personal branding, service presentation, and a clear booking journey in a cohesive coaching website. The result is a digital platform that communicates Maya's specialization in blended family relationships, introduces her coaching approach, and helps prospective clients explore the support available to them. The project demonstrates my approach to building service-based websites that combine user-focused design, structured information, and clear calls to action to support trust and client engagement.

title: Qudra: Arab Philanthropy Network
desc: Developed a trilingual website for Qudra: Arab Philanthropy Network, featuring Arabic, English, and Hebrew language support, RTL-compatible layouts, and a custom accessibility plugin to improve usability and inclusive access to information.
overview: Qudra: Building an Accessible, Trilingual Digital Experience Project Overview Qudra: Arab Philanthropy Network is an organization focused on strengthening strategic philanthropy within Arab society. The network connects donors, community leaders, civil society organizations, and philanthropic institutions to encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and sustainable social impact. The project involved developing a multilingual digital platform that communicates Qudra's mission, showcases its initiatives, and makes its resources accessible to a diverse audience. The website supports Arabic, English, and Hebrew, bringing together organizational information, publications, events, and community initiatives within a consistent digital experience. The Challenge Developing a website for a multilingual organization requires more than translating content. Each language introduces considerations around text direction, typography, navigation, layout consistency, and usability. Arabic and Hebrew require right-to-left (RTL) layouts, while English follows a left-to-right (LTR) direction. The challenge was to maintain a cohesive visual identity across all three language versions while ensuring that navigation, content structure, and interactive elements remained intuitive. Accessibility was another important consideration. The website needed to provide a more inclusive browsing experience for visitors with different accessibility requirements without compromising the overall design or usability. My Approach My approach focused on multilingual website development, responsive interface design, RTL/LTR layout handling, and custom accessibility functionality. The goal was to create a flexible digital platform that supports the organization's communication needs while making its content easier to navigate and access. Trilingual Website Development The website supports Arabic, English, and Hebrew, allowing visitors to explore Qudra's mission, activities, resources, and initiatives in their preferred language. The multilingual structure maintains consistent navigation and content presentation across the different language versions. RTL and LTR Layout Implementation Supporting both right-to-left and left-to-right languages requires careful handling of layout alignment, text flow, spacing, navigation, and interface components. The website incorporates language-specific layout considerations to accommodate Arabic and Hebrew alongside English. This helps maintain a consistent user experience while respecting the structural requirements of each language. Custom Accessibility Plugin A key feature of the project was the development of a custom accessibility plugin that provides additional accessibility controls and supports a more inclusive browsing experience. The custom implementation was designed to integrate with the website's interface while improving the usability of its content and navigation. Accessibility was treated as part of the overall website experience rather than an isolated feature. Responsive Web Design The website was developed with responsive layouts to support access across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Content sections, navigation, and interface elements were structured to remain usable across different screen sizes and language directions. Content and Information Architecture Qudra's website brings together organizational information, strategic initiatives, knowledge resources, newsletters, events, and community-focused content. The content structure helps visitors understand the organization's mission, explore its core pillars of knowledge, networking, strategic partnerships, and collaborative giving, and discover opportunities to engage with the network. Key Features Trilingual website supporting Arabic, English, and Hebrew RTL and LTR layout support Custom accessibility plugin Responsive website design Structured content and navigation Organizational and initiative pages Knowledge resources and publications Newsletter and event sections Accessibility-focused interface improvements Technologies and Tools HTML and CSS: Semantic structure, styling, and responsive layouts JavaScript: Interactive functionality and custom accessibility controls Multilingual Development: Language-specific content and layout handling RTL/LTR Implementation: Support for right-to-left and left-to-right interfaces Website Customization: Tailored functionality and interface improvements Project Outcome Qudra's website brings together multilingual communication, responsive web development, and custom accessibility functionality in a unified digital platform. The project supports the organization's goal of connecting communities, sharing knowledge, and promoting strategic philanthropy through an online experience designed for a diverse audience. The combination of Arabic, English, and Hebrew support with a custom accessibility plugin demonstrates my experience in multilingual website development, RTL interface implementation, and building more inclusive digital experiences for organizations serving diverse communities.

title: Black Fridye
desc: Developed a digital experience for Black Fridye, a sustainable clothing overdyeing initiative by Citizen Wolf that helps people refresh existing garments by dyeing them black, extending usable life and reducing the environmental impact of buying new clothes.
overview: Black Fridye: Building an Ecommerce Experience for Sustainable Fashion Project Overview Black Fridye is a sustainable fashion initiative by Citizen Wolf that offers a garment overdyeing service designed to help people love their existing clothes for longer. Instead of replacing faded or unwanted garments, customers can send eligible clothing to be dyed black and refreshed for continued use. The project brings together ecommerce functionality, sustainability-focused messaging, and a distinctive brand identity to encourage more conscious clothing consumption. The website communicates the environmental benefits of extending garment life while guiding visitors through the process of selecting a service, understanding garment eligibility, and participating in the initiative. The Challenge Sustainable fashion services require a clear explanation of both the practical process and the environmental value behind the offering. Visitors need to understand which garments can be dyed, how the service works, what the process involves, and how extending the life of existing clothing can reduce waste. The challenge was to present this information in an engaging and accessible way while maintaining a clear purchasing journey. The website also needed to communicate environmental impact through relevant statistics and make service options easy to understand. My Approach The website experience combines product-style service listings, educational content, and sustainability-focused messaging. overviewHtml:
Black Fridye: Building an Ecommerce Experience for Sustainable Fashion

Project Overview

Black Fridye is a sustainable fashion initiative by Citizen Wolf that offers a garment overdyeing service designed to help people love their existing clothes for longer. Instead of replacing faded or unwanted garments, customers can send eligible clothing to be dyed black and refreshed for continued use.

The project brings together ecommerce functionality, sustainability-focused messaging, and a distinctive brand identity to encourage more conscious clothing consumption. The website communicates the environmental benefits of extending garment life while guiding visitors through the process of selecting a service, understanding garment eligibility, and participating in the initiative.

The Challenge

Sustainable fashion services require a clear explanation of both the practical process and the environmental value behind the offering. Visitors need to understand which garments can be dyed, how the service works, what the process involves, and how extending the life of existing clothing can reduce waste.

The challenge was to present this information in an engaging and accessible way while maintaining a clear purchasing journey. The website also needed to communicate environmental impact through relevant statistics and make service options easy to understand.

My Approach

The website experience combines product-style service listings, educational content, and sustainability-focused messaging. The structure guides visitors from understanding the concept of Black Fridye to exploring eligible garment categories and learning how to participate.

Ecommerce Experience and Service Selection

The website organizes the overdyeing service into garment categories, including tops, bottoms, jackets, and dresses. Each category communicates the service offering alongside relevant environmental impact information, helping visitors understand the available options before proceeding.

Sustainability-Focused Storytelling

Environmental responsibility is central to the Black Fridye brand. The website explains how refreshing existing clothing can help reduce the need for new garment production and highlights the potential savings in water consumption and carbon emissions.

This messaging connects the practical service with the broader concept of circular fashion, encouraging customers to reconsider how they maintain and reuse their clothing.

User Experience and Information Architecture

The website combines service descriptions, process explanations, frequently asked questions, and clear calls to action. This structure helps visitors understand how the service works, determine whether their garments are suitable, and find answers to common questions before making a decision.

Product Information and Garment Eligibility

Garment composition plays an important role in the overdyeing process. The website explains which fabrics generally respond well to dyeing and which materials, trims, and synthetic blends may not produce the desired results.

Presenting these details through dedicated information sections helps establish realistic expectations and supports more informed customer decisions.

Responsive Web Design

The website brings together service categories, informational content, and calls to action in a structured layout designed for browsing across devices. The focus is on keeping the experience clear and consistent while making essential service information easy to find.

Key Features

  • Ecommerce-style service selection for garment overdyeing

  • Dedicated categories for tops, bottoms, jackets, and dresses

  • Sustainability messaging and environmental impact statistics

  • Step-by-step explanation of the garment dyeing process

  • Frequently asked questions about fabrics and garment eligibility

  • Clear calls to action and newsletter sign-up

  • Responsive website layout

  • Content structure focused on sustainable clothing reuse

Technologies and Tools

  • Ecommerce Development: Online service presentation and purchasing journey

  • HTML and CSS: Page structure, styling, and responsive layouts

  • JavaScript: Interactive functionality, where implemented

  • UI/UX Design: Information hierarchy, service navigation, and customer journey design

Project Outcome

Black Fridye presents garment overdyeing as an accessible alternative to replacing existing clothing. By combining service-focused ecommerce design with educational content and sustainability messaging, the website communicates the value of extending garment life through a straightforward digital experience.

The project demonstrates an approach to building purpose-driven ecommerce experiences that connect brand storytelling, service presentation, and user experience around a clear sustainability mission.
